title: Bill 111 on removing belongings from public places
summary: Bill 111 sets steps for relocating people from public places and storing their property, with 45 days' notice and 90 days' storage. In March 2025 a county lawyer reviewed the Davis v. Bissen decision, and the bill was deferred to return with amendments after the budget.

timeline.text: The chair urged commissioners to watch a December 3 meeting and review the bill.
A testifier said people could not get back belongings taken in homeless sweeps.
